findings.text: Provides a global updater for the swapper page directory entry used when a folded upper level aliases the top directory. When early mappings remain writable it completes with an ordered store and barriers, otherwise it serializes a fixmap mediated update and release.

Exposes allocation of a fresh page table page owned by the initial address space for a requested table level, returning a sentinel physical address on exhaustion. Level specific construction is applied before the address is handed back.

Upper level traversal collapses the next level into its parent when the widest address configuration is disabled, and otherwise resolves through the parent entry physical address plus an index. The outer entry point samples the parent once before delegating to the lockless resolver, keeping the sampled value consistent for the walk.
Level indexes derive from the virtual address by shifting to the level base and masking to the per table entry count, yielding the slot used by both folded alias computation and true table lookup.

Folded helpers align the supplied upper pointer down to the table base before adding the lower index, and they assert that the supplied pointer already corresponds to the supplied address so mismatched walks are caught in debug builds.
When the intermediate level is compiled out, querying its page physical address is a build time error, while the enabled configuration converts through the generic entry to physical helper.

Presence at the top level is the negation of emptiness, and page address extraction at top levels funnels through a common entry conversion. Lower physical to table value encodings alias the base entry encoding, and physical to virtual translation uses the linear map helper.

Installing a leaf entry separates an unordered store from a completion step. Completion only requests ordering for mappings that are valid and privileged, deferring through a per thread pending marker while lazy mode is active and emitting immediately otherwise. Emission orders the store for walker visibility and clears stale pipeline state.

Intermediate installers perform an ordered store and request barriers only for valid entries. When the target lies in the swapper directory under a folded configuration they redirect through the global swapper updater instead of storing directly.

Contiguous group teardown normalizes the supplied pointer to its group base and clears the contiguous attribute across every member, using leaf stores for the lowest level and intermediate installers for the block level.

Splitting a block mapping allocates a fresh lower table from the initial address space, preserves permission attributes while translating the block type to table or leaf form, normalizes the contiguous attribute before optionally restoring it, fills the new table over the covered range, orders the fills for walker visibility, then publishes the parent table entry. Allocation exhaustion is reported as a memory error.

Updates to the swapper directory through the fixmap window are serialized by a dedicated spin lock held across mapping, store and unmapping, while the early writable mapping fast path performs no locking.
Nested probe record holds a pointer to the outer probe, a numeric status, and the saved interrupt mask of the outer probe preserved across reentry so nested handling does not lose the original state.
Per task probe control holds a status word, the saved interrupt mask for the current probe, and an embedded nested record for reentry.

Debugger register file defines general count 33 [CITED], floating count 32 [CITED] and extra count 3 [CITED], with general bytes as count times 8 [CITED] and total register bytes combining general times 8 [CITED] plus floating times 16 [CITED] plus extra times 4 [CITED]. Maximum register number is the sum of the group counts and the buffer limit is 2048 [CITED].
Probe support requests an instruction slot, allows at most 2 [CITED] slots per probe, defines slot flush as a no operation, and reports return probe blacklist size 0 [CITED].
Hypervisor control short names alias the corresponding architected control fields, providing a uniform local prefix for trap, attenuation, virtualization and interrupt routing controls.

Guest entry uses a fixed combination of trap, shareability, routing and address size controls, while host modes use smaller fixed combinations selecting execution state and interrupt routing, with the protected host variant adding an additional trap. The measurement host flags value is 0 [CITED], indicating no extra controls.

Translation control defines a disable shareability bit at position 32 [CITED], reserved bits combining positions 31 [CITED] and 23 [CITED], hierarchical controls at positions 24 [CITED] and 21 [CITED], top byte control at 20 [CITED], physical size field starting at 16 [CITED] with width 3 [CITED] and an encoding selecting 40 [CITED] bits, plus granularity shareability and cacheability masks and a size mask of width 6 [CITED] combined into an overall mask.

Virtualization translation control selects granule 64 [CITED] KiB with base 3 [CITED], granule 16 [CITED] KiB with base 3 [CITED], and granule 4 [CITED] KiB with base 2 [CITED] across builds. Helpers convert between table level counts and start level values using the selected base, derive level counts from a control value, fix shareability cacheability granule and reserved bits for flags, and derive address width from the size field.

Stage address helpers derive a table offset from address width and level count, define a coalescing bit value 1 [CITED], a virtual machine identifier shift 48 [CITED] with a sized mask, a per index single bit selector for system register traps, trap bits at fixed positions with distinct reserved set and clear masks for host modes, a floating trap shift 10 [CITED], and a fault address mask clearing low 4 [CITED] bits.
Debugger entry provides a compiled breakpoint primitive and a single step handler that reports an unhandled hook error, indicating stepping is not supported in this configuration.
Direct map manipulation for the sanitizer is permitted only after early initialization completes in the enabled build, and is unconditionally denied in the disabled build.

Publishing a parent table entry before its new child entries are visible to the walker risks fetching stale entries, so splits order child fills before the parent store and installers request barriers for valid entries.

Using a level that is folded out of the build triggers a compile time failure for address queries and child population, and validity queries for the absent level report false, so callers must respect the enabled level configuration.

Table allocation can fail and is signaled with a sentinel address that split callers translate into a memory exhaustion error, while misuse of the top level constructor is flagged as a programming error.

Barrier handling has active and idle modes. When lazy mode is active the request sets a pending marker and defers emission, otherwise it emits immediately. The pending marker later drives a deferred emission.
Top level walk entry resolves the next level descriptor for a virtual address from a directory pointer, serving as the stable call site for traversal with folding handled internally.

Frame number and protection conversions round trip through address shifting and value masking, with attribute extraction using a null protection construction combined by exclusive or, and invalid marking recorded via a present invalid flag while clearing validity.
Headers define inclusion guards to prevent multiple inclusion.
Swapper updates use a dedicated fixmap slot with paired set and clear helpers.
